;Business and economy
*[[Expansion of Heathrow Airport]]
**The [[Cabinet of the United Kingdom]] approves a controversial third runway at [[London]]'s [[Heathrow Airport]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/battle-looms-after-government-gives-go-ahead-for-heathrow-third-runway-11395738 (Sky News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 lower Puna eruption]]
**A lava flow destroys at least 130 homes in the [[Vacationland Hawaii]] and Kapoho Beach Lots neighborhoods. Officials reported Vacationland Hawaii to be completely destroyed, while nearby [[Kapoho, Hawaii|Kapoho Bay]] has been filled with lava. [http://www.westhawaiitoday.com/2018/06/06/hawaii-news/vacationland-completely-covered-by-lava/ (''West Hawaii Today'')] [http://www.westhawaiitoday.com/2018/06/06/hawaii-news/lava-continues-to-fill-kapoho-bay/ (''West Hawaii Today''<sub>2</sub>)]
*[[Mining accident]]s
**An explosion at an iron ore mine in [[Benxi]], [[Liaoning]], kills 11 people, 23 others were rescued from the site, while 2 more remain trapped. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-blast/iron-ore-mine-blast-in-chinas-northeast-kills-11-state-media-idUSKCN1J11PE (Reuters)]
*[[2018 Volcán de Fuego eruption]]
**The death toll for the [[Volcán de Fuego]] eruption in [[Guatemala]] rises to 75 people. [https://huffpost.com/us/entry/us_5b161d1ce4b093ac33a12687 (''HuffPost'')]

;International relations
*[[Eritrean–Ethiopian border conflict]]
**[[Ethiopia]] agrees to "fully accept" the outcome of the [[Algiers Agreement (2000)|Algiers Agreement of 2000]], which ruled that disputed areas, including the border town of [[Badme]] which Ethiopia currently occupies, are [[Eritrea]]n territory. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-44376298 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*[[LGBT rights in the European Union]]
**The [[European Court of Justice]] rules that [[European Union|EU]] countries that have not legalised [[same-sex marriage]] must still offer same-sex spouses the same residency rights as heterosexual couples under [[freedom of movement]] laws. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2018/06/05/top-eu-court-rules-same-sex-spouses-have-rights-countries-have/ (''The Telegraph'')]
*[[Prostitution in Belgium]]
**[[Prostitution|Prostitutes]] in [[Brussels]]' [[Rue d'Aerschot]] [[Red-light districts in Belgium|red-light district]] go on strike today after one of their colleagues is found murdered this morning. [https://www.hln.be/nieuws/binnenland/prostituees-aan-noordstation-leggen-werk-neer-na-nieuwe-moord-op-collega~a4e35004/ (''Het Laatste Nieuws'')] <!-- English article needed -->
*[[Hurricane Maria death toll controversy]]
**The [[Government of Puerto Rico|Government]] of [[Puerto Rico]] says that it will comply with a [[Superior Courts of Puerto Rico|Superior Court]] order to release all death certificates issued after [[Hurricane Maria]] hit the U.S. territory. The court order came after [[CNN]] and Puerto Rico's Center for Investigative Journalism sued the territory's government amid [[Hurricane Maria#Likely_undercounting_of_fatalities|allegations of undercounted fatalities]]. [http://www.wdtn.com/news/u-s-world/court-orders-puerto-rico-to-release-stormrelated-death-data/1219559305 (AP via WDTN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Spain]], [[2018 vote of no confidence in the government of Mariano Rajoy]]
**Former [[Prime Minister of Spain|Prime Minister]] [[Mariano Rajoy]] resigns as the leader of [[People's Party (Spain)|People's Party]], four days after losing the [[2018 vote of no confidence in the government of Mariano Rajoy|no-confidence vote]] that ended his [[Rajoy II Government|premiership]]. [https://elpais.com/elpais/2018/06/05/inenglish/1528198456_568025.html (''El País'' English)]
*[[Politics of Jordan]]
**In an effort to quell unrest caused by [[International Monetary Fund|IMF]]-driven reforms, [[King of Jordan|King]] [[Abdullah II of Jordan]] appoints [[Omar Razzaz]] as [[Prime Minister of Jordan|Prime Minister]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-jordan-protests/jordans-king-appoints-economist-to-form-new-government-calls-for-tax-dialogue-idUSKCN1J118U (Reuters)]
*[[Politics of Ethiopia]]
**[[FBC (Fana Broadcasting Corporate S.C.)|Fana Broadcasting]] reports that the [[Federal Parliamentary Assembly|Parliament]] of [[Ethiopia]] approves a bill and lifts the [[state of emergency]], two months earlier than planned. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/06/ethiopia-lifts-state-emergency-imposed-february-180605081810759.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Me Too movement]], [[Judicial independence]]
**Voters in [[Santa Clara County, California]] vote to [[recall election|recall]] Judge [[Aaron Persky]] after he sentenced a swimmer convicted of sexual assault to six months in jail in 2016. [http://www.whsv.com/content/news/Judge-who-sentenced-Brock-Turner-ousted-amid-MeToo-movement-484756181.html (AP via WHSV)]
